scenes.text: People think ghosts come from the past. That's adorable. Most ghosts are alive, and they haunt forward.
scenes.visual: an ordinary person casting a long shadow into a brightly lit hallway that stretches toward dawn

scenes.text: Every choice you avoid moves into tomorrow before you do, then starts rearranging the furniture.
scenes.visual: an unfinished apartment where moving boxes and chairs sit half-arranged under morning light

scenes.text: The email you won't answer becomes a locked door your future self inherits.
scenes.visual: a heavy office door with an unanswered envelope resting beneath it

scenes.text: The hour you keep stealing from sleep returns wearing your face and carrying a fog machine.
scenes.visual: a bedside alarm clock at sunrise while dense fog spills across a rumpled bedroom floor

scenes.text: A habit is just a tiny employee. Repeat it enough, and it becomes management.
scenes.visual: a miniature factory line where one small worker operates a growing bank of levers

scenes.text: Soon, your calendar is being run by decisions you barely remember hiring.
scenes.visual: a crowded wall calendar surrounded by clocks, keys, and neatly stacked appointment cards

scenes.text: This is the strange part: tomorrow is not waiting for you. Tomorrow is being built out of your leftovers.
scenes.visual: a workshop assembling a luminous new room from scraps, spare wood, and discarded objects

scenes.text: Your future self doesn't meet you. They wake up inside the weather you manufactured.
scenes.visual: a person standing in an artificial weather chamber beneath rain, wind, and a shaft of sunlight

scenes.text: They call it a mood. Sometimes it's simply yesterday's unpaid electricity bill humming in the walls.
scenes.visual: an old apartment wall glowing faintly around electrical wires and a vibrating power meter

scenes.text: They call it bad luck. Sometimes it's a bridge you removed one plank at a time.
scenes.visual: a suspension bridge over a canyon with a trail of missing wooden planks

scenes.text: And yes, this works in reverse.
scenes.visual: a clear river flowing backward around dark stones toward a distant mountain

scenes.text: One glass of water can travel through time disguised as a better morning.
scenes.visual: a glass of water on a bedside table refracting the first orange light of sunrise

scenes.text: Ten honest minutes on a hard problem can become a door that opens from the other side.
scenes.visual: hands working at a cluttered bench while a distant door slowly opens into daylight

scenes.text: Putting your shoes by the bed is a message sent to someone who shares your fingerprints but not your exhaustion.
scenes.visual: a pair of shoes placed neatly beside a bed in quiet blue moonlight

scenes.text: You don't need to transform your life tonight. Transformation is usually procrastination wearing ceremonial robes.
scenes.visual: an ornate ceremonial robe hanging beside a plain broom, towel, and toolbox

scenes.text: You need to stop leaving booby traps for the person arriving after midnight.
scenes.visual: a dim home hallway as scattered cords, boxes, and loose objects are cleared from the path

scenes.text: Wash one plate. Set one boundary. Write one sentence. Make the hallway slightly less haunted.
scenes.visual: a clean plate drying beside a closed garden gate and a pencil resting on fresh paper

scenes.text: Small kindnesses are not small when they cross time.
scenes.visual: a tiny seed passing through a glass hourglass and emerging below as a green shoot

scenes.text: They compound like light passing from mirror to mirror, surviving rooms you haven't entered yet.
scenes.visual: a beam of sunlight traveling through a corridor of mirrors into unopened rooms

scenes.text: Eventually, your future self will stand somewhere impossible to imagine from here.
scenes.visual: a lone figure at a mountain observatory looking across clouds toward a vast horizon

scenes.text: They will think they did it alone, because your fingerprints have faded from the tools.
scenes.visual: a worn hammer, wrench, and paintbrush on a workbench with polished handles

scenes.text: But every stable floor beneath them will contain some quiet decision you made without applause.
scenes.visual: warm wooden floorboards being fitted one by one beneath a peaceful finished room

scenes.text: So before today closes, leave tomorrow one piece of evidence that somebody was looking out for it.
scenes.visual: a small lamp left glowing beside prepared coffee, folded clothes, and a waiting key

scenes.text: When the next version of you arrives, what do you want them to find waiting?
scenes.visual: an open doorway at dawn with a coat, chair, and clear path waiting beyond it
